progress_commit: verified victory uses D1 transaction and unique(player_id,run_id); highest_verified_cell only increases for next unlocked cell; repeated callback returns same result; reward grants absent
cell_index_formula: rank * 10 + chapter; initially highest_verified_cell=0; selectable cell <= min(60,highest_verified_cell+1)
defeat: current run ends; new attempt resets XP/objectives/build, leaves highest_verified_cell unchanged
abandon: same as defeat without defeat story; cannot submit abandoned run
resume: restore exact pinned revision and seed, integer state and input prefix; an offer is saved before display; server validates reconstructed input prefix before accepting resume
scene_save: save before pending choice; restore StoryRunner cursor/option IDs; full-scene skip writes seen checkpoint, never awards victory
pause_input: explicit event at tick; tick never advances while paused
offline: practice only until verified-resume adapter exists; no authoritative unlock or reward; UI marks local result pending
multi_device: one active authoritative session per player/mode; server session generation CAS rejects stale device; second device offers resume or explicit abandonment
migration: keep active revisions through bounded retirement window; expired unsupported attempt closes without progress debit; future entry uses new revision; do not reinterpret old seed/stats
retirement_behavior: server clock only expires session, not active combat time; warn user in session UI; rewards still undefined
